all.source_quote: The account can be opened in the name of a girl child.
The girl child should be below 10 years of age at the time of account opening.

unmodelled.text: A parent or legal guardian opens and runs the account until the girl can
unmodelled.source_quote: The account is opened and operated by the parent or legal guardian until the girl child becomes eligible to operate it herself.
Only one account can be opened in the name of one girl child.

unmodelled.text: At most two girls per family
unmodelled.source_quote: A family can generally open accounts for a maximum of two girl children.

unmodelled.text: More than two only in special cases such as twins or triplets
unmodelled.source_quote: Accounts for more than two girl children may be allowed in special cases such as twins or triplets, subject to required documentation.

unmodelled.text: Needs the girl's birth certificate and the guardian's ID and address proof
unmodelled.source_quote: The applicant must submit the birth certificate of the girl child and identity/address proof of the guardian.

ambiguous: Source is a short summary by the Department of Information & Cultural Affairs on wb.gov.in, not the scheme's own guidelines

en.title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
en.benefit: Government-backed savings account for a girl: 8.2% a year now, Rs 250 to Rs 1.5 lakh a year, tax-free, matures after 21 years.
en.how_to_apply: A parent or guardian opens it at a post office or authorised bank with the girl's birth certificate and their own KYC documents.
